message_def.name: RequestHandoff
message_def.description: Creates or updates a request for control handoff from the current controlling client.

fixed_field.name: RequestID
fixed_field.interpretation: Client-generated ID for tracking handoff requests.

message_def.name: QueryHandoffDecisionTimeout
message_def.description: Causes the service to issue a ReportHandoffDecisionTimeout message.

message_def.name: QueryHandoffRequestTimeout
message_def.description: Causes the service to issue a ReportHandoffRequestTimeout message.

message_def.name: RemoveHandoffRequest
message_def.description: Remove a request for handoff control.

fixed_field.name: RequestID
fixed_field.interpretation: Client-generated ID for tracking handoff requests. This should match an ID from a previous RequestHandoff message.

message_def.name: ConfirmHandoffRequest
message_def.description: Confirms that there is a response to a handoff request. The response can be: GRANTED, meaning the request for handoff was granted and the requesting client has control; NOT_AVAILABLE, meaning control (and thus handoff) is not available; HANDOFF_REQUEST_TIMEOUT, meaning the handoff request timed out because it was not re-issued within a set amount of time to the handoff request; DENIED, meaning the current controlling client rejected the request for handoff; QUEUED, meaning the handoff request was queued and pending; DEFERRED, meaning the current controller is not prepared to make a decision on the request; INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY, meaning the request did not have a high enough authority code to control the service; HANDOFF_DECISION_TIMEOUT, meaning the current controller did not respond within a set amount of time to the handoff request; SERVICE_NOT_CONTROLLED, meaning that the service is not currently being controlled; or REMOVED, meaning that the handoff request was removed from the queue.

fixed_field.name: RequestID
fixed_field.interpretation: ID from the RequestHandoff message that established the handoff request.

message_def.name: ReportHandoffDecisionTimeout
message_def.description: Sent in response to a Query Handoff Decision Timeout message. The handoff decision timeout is the amount of time that must pass between this service requesting a handoff from the current controlling client and this service receiving a ConfirmReleaseControl message in response before that handoff request is considered failed due to a timeout.

fixed_field.name: HandoffDecisionTimeout
fixed_field.interpretation: The handoff decision timeout is the amount of time that must pass between this service requesting a handoff from the current controlling client and this service receiving a ConfirmReleaseControl message in response before that handoff request is considered failed due to a timeout.. A value of zero indicates this feature is disabled.

message_def.name: ReportHandoffRequestTimeout
message_def.description: Sent in response to a Query Handoff Request Timeout message. The handoff request timeout is the maximum amount of time between a client reasserting its desire for a handoff before that request for a handoff is considered timed out.

fixed_field.name: HandoffRequestTimeout
fixed_field.interpretation: The handoff request timeout is the maximum amount of time between a client reasserting its desire for a handoff before that request for a handoff is considered timed out. A value of zero indicates this feature is disabled.
